comparison.objective: Empty a robot-vacuum dustbin and reseat it; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Trap-door actuation and container pouring versus bimanual screen agitation, orientation-dependent aperture passage, and part retention.
comparison.success_condition: Dust transferred and bin reseated versus ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, and released screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Both handle granular contents, but only the candidate tests physical size separation and bridge clearing through a screen.
